captured_source: oscillator output selected; physical frequency unknown
post_cache_terminal_write: 0x80 to RCR 0xec090000 requests software reset; it does not establish a power-hold latch
assurance_limits: Payload-only lower bounds exclude command/CRC overhead, CPU copies, input/interrupt latency, data-cache/memory timing, eMMC programming/busy time and durability. They are not required hold-up budgets or measured shutdown times.

E10 stores records in existing serialized slots; the shutdown writer has the same fixed count. Equal volume does not prove equal physical timing. Edge-sensitive level-7 requests are nonmaskable; IPL 7 alone does not protect custom updates from that input. The level-5 callback handoff and interrupted-update behavior need separate coverage.
Only captured PC register values are decoded; hardware bootstrap oscillator/source/divider state is not measured. No capacitance, rail current, minimum voltage or signal threshold is known.

Without opening/measuring the unit or obtaining authoritative board hold-up specifications, the available evidence cannot establish a positive physical margin. LEDs/audio stopping do not observe internal eMMC write completion.
